saw_lines: Game buyers wait for the sale. They wishlist a title, watch the price, then buy the moment the discount lands.
So the sale is won in the ad itself, when the discount shows before the buyer scrolls past.
Your site lists offers from 10% off to 60% off, yet the Google text ads name none of them. Open the next ads with 60% off in line one.
